applies_why: The judge text grants DEFENDER WINS while the only stated CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade is expressly retracted and the standing's stated reason is therefore retracted, so it decides the RESULT rule.
quote: STATEMENT: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 / CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1; JUDGE STATEMENT: The BROKEN grade is retracted
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: I read 'A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count' as either (1) the C3-broken reason is retracted, so the standing does not count, or (2) the retraction affects only the collision grade and leaves the PROP-DEPENDENT standing intact.
why: Because the only collision grade supporting DEFENDER WINS is retracted and the standing's stated reason is thereby retracted, the judge text awards DEFENDER WINS contrary to the RESULT rule.
